name: QuoteBot
description: Automated quote generator and email sender

props.text: Hi! Let’s get you a quote. What’s your full name?

const prices = { chatbot: 99, receptionist: 199, video: 299, suite: 499 }
if (state.plan === 'custom') { state.quote = 'Custom pricing – depends on needs'; } else { state.quote = `$${prices[state.plan]}/mo`; }
